newsitem.title: THAILAND: Phatra Thanakit says mulls merger.
newsitem.headline: Phatra Thanakit says mulls merger.

text.p: Securities and finance firm Phatra Thanakit Plc said on Thursday it was weighing the benefits of a merger with other financial firms as a prelude for seeking a bank licence.
Phatra Thanakit made the announcement in a statement filed to the Stock Exchange of Thailand.

The news follows a cabinet decision on Tuesday to issue decrees encouraging cash-strapped finance firms to merge as part of plans to bail out finance and property firms hit by a prolonged liquidity crunch and business slump.
The central bank has said merging finance firms could seek new bank licences with foreign equity participation above a current 25 percent limit placed by the authorities.
